spans.s: लव (I) m. 1. Plucking, mowing; 2. a section, a fragment; 3. a drop, a small quantity, a little, आचामति स्वेदलवान्मुखे ते R.xiii.20, भ्रूक्षेपलक्ष्मीलवक्रीते Git.G.xi., आरुक्षाम नृपप्रसादकणिकामद्राक्ष्म लक्ष्मीलवान् Vikr.Ch.xviii.103, R.vi.57, xvi.66; 4. wool, hair; 5. loss, destruction; 6. sport; 7. a minute division of time equal to the sixtieth part of a twinkling; 8. the numerator of a fraction; 9. a degree (in astronomy); 10. name of a son of Rāma; (See App. II.), R.xv.97.
लव (II) n. 1. Nutmeg; 2. cloves.(लवम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘a little.’)
लाव (I) a. (f. वी) 1. Cutting, severing, cutting off, R.xiii.43; 2. plucking, gathering; 3. killing, destroying, Bt.vi.87.
लाव (II) m. 1. Cutting; 2. a quail.
लवंग (I) m. the clove plant, ललितलवंगलतापरिशीलनकोमलमलयसमिरे Git.G.i., R.vi.57.
लवंग (II) m. Cloves.
लवंग-कलिका f. a clove.
लवंगक n. Cloves.
लवण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Saline, briny; 2. lovely, handsome.
लवण (II) m. 1. Saline taste; 2. the sea of salt water; 3. name of a demon, R.xv.2, 5.
लवण (III) n. 1. Salt, sea-salt; 2. a factitious salt.
लवण (I) a. (f. णा) 1. Saline, briny; 2. lovely, handsome.
लवणा f. Lustre, beauty.
लावण a. (f. णी) Salted, dressed with salt.
लवण-अंतक m. an epithet of Śatrughna.
लवण-अब्धि m. the ocean.
लवण-अब्धि˚ज n. sea-salt.
लवण-अंबुराशि m. the ocean, आभाति वेला लवणांबुराशेः R.xiii.15.
लवण-अंभस् (I) m. the ocean, R.xii.70, xvii.54.
लवण-अंभस् (II) n. salt water.
लवण-आकर m. 1. a saltmine; 2. the sea of salt water; 3. a mine of beauty.
लवण-आलय m. the ocean.
लवण-उत्तम n. 1. rock-salt; 2. nitre.
लवण-उद m. the sea of salt water.
लवण-उदक, -उदधि m. the ocean.
लवण-उदक, -उदधि m. the ocean.
लवण-मेह m. a kind of urinary disease.
लवण-समुद्र m. the sea of salt water.
लवणिमन् m. 1. Saltness; 2. beauty, loveliness.
लवन n. 1. Mowing, reaping; 2. an implement for cutting.
लवली f. A species of creeper, लवलीं तव लीलया कपोले कवलीकुर्वति कोमलत्विषा Bh.V.ii.36.
लवित्र n. An implement for cutting, a scythe.
लाव (I) a. (f. वी) 1. Cutting, severing, cutting off, R.xiii.43; 2. plucking, gathering; 3. killing, destroying, Bt.vi.87.
लावक m. 1. A cutter, a divider; 2. a quail.
लावण a. (f. णी) Salted, dressed with salt.
लावणिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Dressed with salt; 2. dealing in salt; 3. lovely, beautiful.
लावणिक (II) m. A salt-merchant.
लावणिक (III) n. A salt-cellar.
लावणिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Dressed with salt; 2. dealing in salt; 3. lovely, beautiful.
लावण्य a. 1. Saltness; 2. beauty, loveliness, charm, पुपोष लावण्यमयान् विशेषान् K.S.i.25, vii.18, (मुक्ताफलेषु छायायास्तरलत्वामिवांतरा । प्रतिभात यदंगेषु तल्लावण्यमिहोच्यते).
लावण्य-अर्जित n. the private property of a married woman presented to her at the time of marriage by her father or mother-in-law.
लावाणक m. Name of a district near Magadha.
लाविक m. A buffalo.
